mainEntity.name: How much does a managed print service cost?

acceptedAnswer.text: It depends entirely on your print volumes, which is why we start with a free print audit. The hardware cost is a one-off purchase (typically spread over 10 interest-free monthly payments). The ongoing service is a simple cost-per-page covering all toner, parts, and engineer callouts. Most businesses find the total cost is significantly lower than what they were spending on ad-hoc toner purchases.

mainEntity.name: What if we don't print enough to justify managed print?

acceptedAnswer.text: Then we'll tell you. Honestly. If your print volumes are low and your current setup is working fine, managed print may not make sense. That's exactly what the print audit is designed to establish - we'll only recommend it if the numbers genuinely stack up.

mainEntity.name: We're currently in a lease contract. Can you help?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We can review your existing contract, identify the notice period and renewal date, and advise on the most cost-effective exit strategy. Even if the end date is years away, getting it in the diary now means you won't miss the cancellation window and get auto-renewed.

We're not tied to any single manufacturer. Our print partner assesses your requirements and recommends the best device for the job regardless of brand. A small office with light printing gets a different recommendation to a busy accounts department churning through thousands of pages a month.

mainEntity.name: What does the service agreement include?

acceptedAnswer.text: Everything except paper. Toner, parts, consumables, labour, callouts, and support are all included in the cost-per-page charge. It's a 12-month rolling agreement - no 5-year lock-ins, no automatic renewals, and you can leave with reasonable notice.

mainEntity.name: Is the print audit really free?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. We deploy monitoring software that runs in the background for around a month and collects the data. We then analyse it and present the findings. If improvements can be made, we'll show you the numbers. If everything is already in good shape, that's the end of it. No obligation, no pressure.

mainEntity.name: Do you cover the whole UK?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes. Our print partner provides national coverage with direct manufacturer warranty and service. Whether you have one office or multiple sites across the country, you're covered.

Business-grade managed printers include features that consumer devices don't: secure print release (documents only print when you authenticate at the device), encrypted storage, access controls, and managed firmware updates. We ensure print devices are properly secured as part of the setup.

content.text: Managed Print The Ultimate Guide to Managed Print Everything you need to know about taking control of your business printing costs. No jargon, no hard sell - just honest advice. Home Resources Managed Print Guide Complete Guide Printing: The Forgotten Line in Your IT Budget Ask most business owners how much they spend on printing and you'll get a blank stare. Yet it's one of the largest unmonitored costs in a typical IT budget - and the less you track something, the more it costs. This guide covers everything from why cheap printers aren't cheap, to how lease contracts catch businesses out, to exactly how a print audit works. Whether you're buying toner from Amazon or locked into a 5-year copier lease, this will help you make better decisions. Cost Control Lease Traps Print Audit What Is Managed Print? Managed print is a complete service that covers your business printing hardware, supplies, and maintenance in one package - so you know exactly what printing costs and never have to think about toner again. Business-Grade Hardware Printers and copiers built for business workloads, not consumer devices repackaged with a higher price tag. The right device for your actual print volumes, regardless of brand. All-Inclusive Service Toner, parts, consumables, labour, and callouts all included. You just add paper. When something goes wrong, a qualified engineer is a phone call away - with national coverage. Monitored Costs A simple cost-per-page model means you always know what printing costs. No more surprise toner orders, no more ad-hoc purchases on Amazon, and no more guessing. The Hidden Cost of Cheap Printers That printer you bought for under a hundred pounds was designed to be cheap to buy and expensive to run. The Razor-and-Blades Problem Printer manufacturers sell hardware at razor-thin margins (some even at a loss) because the real money is in consumables. A set of replacement toner cartridges for a typical desktop colour printer can cost more than the printer itself. Over two to three years, you might spend five to ten times the purchase price on toner alone. Real Example: The Numbers Behind a 'Cheap' Printer HP OfficeJet Pro 8720 Mono cost per page: 1.67p Colour cost per page: 8.80p Monthly print cost at average volumes: ~£199 HP OfficeJet Pro 9010 Mono cost per page: 1.80p Colour cost per page: 6.41p Monthly print cost at average volumes: ~£91 Combined annual running cost: £3,481 - for two printers that cost under £200 each to buy. The Same Workload on a Managed Device Mono cost per page 0.8p Colour cost per page 5p Annual running cost £1,939 Annual saving: £1,542. Over five years: £7,710. The hardware pays for itself within 18 months. Ownership vs Leasing: The Full Picture Over 80% of businesses lease their printing equipment. We think most of them shouldn't. The Typical Lease Model You never own the equipment At the end of 5 years of payments, the leasing company collects the device (at your expense) and you start over You pay far more than the device is worth The leasing company pays the dealer upfront, then charges you the capital cost plus interest, admin fees, insurance, and more You're forced to upgrade on their schedule Most leased devices would happily run for 8-10 years, but the lease forces replacement at year 5 whether you need it or not Walking away is deliberately expensive Termination clauses ensure that even when you know you're overpaying, it costs more to leave than to stay Our Ownership Model You own the device outright Pay once (or over 10 interest-free monthly instalments) and it's yours. No lease, no residual value games Run it for as long as it works Business-grade devices last the best part of a decade. Replace it when you need to, not when a contract tells you to 0% interest purchase plan available Spread the cost over 10 monthly payments with no deposit and no third-party finance company involved 12-month rolling service - no lock-in A simple service agreement covering toner, parts, and callouts. Leave with reasonable notice if you're not happy Case Study: The £40,000 Copier Lease A business approached us coming into the last year of a 5-year copier lease. They had two HP Color LaserJet MFPs on a lease costing £2,000 per quarter (£1,000 per machine). Over the full 5-year term, they would have spent £40,000 on two copiers they didn't even own at the end. The equivalent devices through us would cost approximately £3,500 each to purchase outright - roughly £7,000 total. The customer used our 0% purchase plan to spread the cost over 10 months. Once paid, they own the equipment and can run it for as long as it serves them. 5-year lease cost £40,000 Owned nothing at the end Purchase cost ~£7,000 Owned outright Saving £33,000 Over the lease term The business also moved from a 5-year service contract to a 12-month rolling agreement. No more being handcuffed to a supplier. They didn't even need new equipment - the existing devices had years of life left. They were only being replaced because the lease was up. What to Watch Out For in Print Contracts The print industry has a tarnished reputation for good reason. If something looks too good to be true, it probably is. Here are the tactics to be aware of. Volume Commitments Toner Coverage Limitations Development Meters (Colour Print Trick) Termination Clauses Automatic Renewal Hidden Fees Annual Price Increases Our position: We publish clear pricing, use 12-month rolling service agreements, don't require volume commitments, and don't hide fees in the small print. If that sounds different to what you're used to, it's because it is. Read more about our approach on our managed print service page. How Our Free Print Audit Works Not sure if managed print would benefit your business? The print audit is the fastest way to find out. No cost, no commitment - just data. 1 Monitor We deploy an intelligent monitoring agent to your network. It identifies every printing device you're running and begins tracking usage data - how much each device prints, in colour and mono, and the associated costs. This runs quietly in the background for around four weeks. 2 Analyse Our print specialists analyse the collected data, break down the running costs of your current equipment, and build a comprehensive report on your current situation. This includes cost per page, total monthly and annual expenditure, and where waste is occurring. 3 Improve We present the findings to you. If improvements can be made, we'll have real facts and figures to back it up, along with detailed recommendations. If your setup is already in good shape, we'll tell you that too. No pressure, no obligation. What the Print Audit Report Covers Current equipment running costs Full usage report by device Detailed print volume breakdown Average annual consumable spend Recommendations for improvement Projected savings with managed print The Security Side of Print Printers are network devices. An unsecured printer is a genuine entry point for attackers. In 2020, ethical hacking group CyberNews demonstrated this by remotely accessing nearly 28,000 unsecured printers worldwide. These weren't sophisticated attacks - they simply found devices exposed to the internet with no security configured. Consumer printers typically have no meaningful security features. Business-grade managed devices include protections that most businesses don't know they need until it's too late. Secure Print Release Documents only print when the user authenticates at the device. No more sensitive papers left in the output tray. Encrypted Storage Documents held in the printer's memory are encrypted, protecting data at rest. Access Controls Restrict who can print, copy, scan, and access device settings. Managed Firmware Updates Firmware is kept up to date as part of the service, closing known vulnerabilities. If you're working towards Cyber Essentials certification or improving your overall cyber security posture, your print devices should be part of that conversation. Our Commitments We work with a specialist print partner who shares our approach to honest, transparent business. Nothing Hidden Below the Line What we quote is what you'll pay. No surprise fees, no hidden clauses, no inflated charges buried in the small print. No Long-Term Contracts 12-month rolling service agreements with easy termination. We'll never ask you to sign a 5-year contract. No Hard Sell If our proposal makes sense, the numbers will speak for themselves. We don't do pressure selling. Complete Honesty If managed print doesn't make financial sense for your business, we'll tell you. We'd rather earn your trust than take your money for something you don't need. Qualified Engineers Direct manufacturer warranty with nationally covered, fully qualified engineers trained on the specific equipment you have. No Brand Loyalty The right device for the job, regardless of manufacturer. Recommendations based on your needs, not our commission structure.
